assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md

lead-routing.ts returns on headcount and region rules before any model call: `if (lead.headcount > 1000) return ...;` and `if (regionCount >= 3) return ...;`, and the test 'hard rules and empty input skip Jev' ensures Jev is not called in these cases.

rolloutRequest sets `model: 'typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917'` (pinned build), and evaluate() calls `decide(request, 'http', key)` which in decisions.ts posts to `DECISIONS_URL = 'https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions'`.
rolloutRequest sends `state: { lookingFor }` only, and the test asserts `request.state` deep-equals `{ lookingFor: lead.lookingFor }`, with no headcount or region info included.
